statement: Contributions explain the XGBoost model's output in log-odds margin space. They are not evidence of fraud, causality or coordination. VAL labels shaped the model's iteration count and threshold, so these VAL explanations are descriptive and not held-out. Features are anonymised: columns are named, mechanisms are not.
